How this repo was made... [(Notes to Self)]{.small .text-muted}

## New repo

A new public repository, [**sgm_py**]{.text-primary}, was created on <i class="bi bi-github"></i>, including a basic README.md and LICENSE files.

Cloned to a local directory
```bash
gh repo clone anw-sh/sgm_py
```

Made new directories
```bash
cd sgm_py
mkdir -p src/sgm_py docs tests
```

Generated a Quarto website with [*docs*]{.text-info} as the parent directory. Required `qmd` files were created, and published as <i class="bi bi-github"></i> pages
```bash
cd docs
quarto publish gh-pages
```

The `root` of `gh-pages` branch was used as source for the [documentation](https://anw-sh.github.io/sgm_py/) site.

Added the cleaned scripts of [mga_p](https://github.com/anw-sh/mga_p) repo to [*src/sgm_py*]{.text-info} directory.

Each script is being documented and saved as website pages.

Changes were committed to the `main` branch.
```bash
# In the sgm_py directory
git add .
git commit -m 'Add scripts'
git push origin main
```
